description: Animating an element as it leaves. Requires keeping it mounted until the animation ends, because unmounting removes the DOM node instantly.
React events fired when a CSS animation or transition finishes. They bubble, so check `event.target` when children animate too.
Media query reflecting the OS setting to minimize motion. Read it in CSS with `@media` or in JS with `matchMedia`.
The library formerly called Framer Motion. `<AnimatePresence>` plus an `exit` prop handles exit animations declaratively.
`transform` and `opacity` animate without triggering layout or paint of other elements.
